newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Esprit Asia seeks worldwide interest.
newsitem.headline: Esprit Asia seeks worldwide interest.

text.p: Esprit Asia Holdings Ltd said the company had entered into discussions with its chairman to acquire his interest in most of the Esprit Worldwide Companies, the company said in an announcement published on Friday.
Esprit Worldwide Companies consists of Esprit Far East Ltd, Espirit de Corp GmbH, and Esprit Holdings Inc, which together conduct or control most global distribution of Esprit produts.
Esprit Far East holds about 70 percent of Esprit Asia.

Esprit Asia said it was in preliminary discussions with Michael Ying Lee Yuen, chairman and chief executive officer of the company, to acquire his entire stake in Esprit Worldwide Companies, other than in the company itself and Esprit Holdings.

Esprit Asia noted Ying had informed it that the shareholders of Esprit Worldwide, other than Ying himself, had entered into a conditional agreement to dispose of their interest to companies controlled by Ying.

That agreement was conditional on financing and was expected to be completed on or before December 19, 1996, and any acquisition by Esprit Asia of Ying's Esprit Worldwide interests would be subsequent to the first agreement.
Ying currently holds 50 percent of Esprit Far East and is chairman and chief executive officer of that company.
